title: Michael Hudecheck
text:
I am an Assistant Professor of Entrepreneurship at Eastern Washington University, where I conduct research on venture financing outcomes using computationally intensive methods and data sources. My most recent research focuses on the consequences of reputational violations in the digital attention landscape.
I have publications in MIT Sloan Management Review, Nature Communications Earth & Environment, and IEEE Transactions on Engineering Management, as well as manuscripts under revise and resubmit at the Journal of Business Venturing and Strategic Management Journal. My work has been presented at the Academy of Management, the European Academy of Management, the Babson College Entrepreneurship Research Conference, where my submission was selected for Best Paper Proceedings, and the Strategic Management Society, where my co-authored submission was nominated for the SMS Strategy Practice Interest Group’s Best Responsible Research Paper Award

title: Grants
text:
Grants (Supported)
Institute lead, Swiss National Science Foundation Indo-Swiss Collaboration Grant “Investigating Informal Entrepreneurship in Indian Slums with Satellite Data.” (2024-Current). University of St. Gallen.
Siren, Charlotta, Grichnik, Dietmar, Wincent, Joakim, & George, Gerard. (2020-2023). Swiss National Science Foundation Grant #31CA30_196293: Tracking and Managing the Economic and Social Impacts of COVID-19 through Collective Emotions, Media Traces, and Satellite-Based Remote Sensing Data. Award Amount 296.9K CHF (Approx. 320.6K USD).
I led the conceptualization, drafting, and implementation of this two-year Swiss National Science Foundation grant, which used emerging data sources — including satellite-based remote sensing data and digital media trace data — to investigate the social and economic impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic, and which funded my Ph.D. studies from Spring 2020 to Summer 2023.
